step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates Intent's serverless data analytics pipeline on AWS. Event data enters the platform from API Gateway (frontend JavaScript) and ECS (backend ad servers), which publish binary Avro-encoded events using KPL into an Ingestion Kinesis Stream. Processor Lambda functions consume these streams, fetching schema and reference data from a Schema S3 Bucket (avoiding VPC ENI overhead). Processed events are published to a Processed Kinesis Stream, serving as an integration point. From there, Kinesis Firehose delivers events to a Storage S3 Bucket. A batch process deduplicates, concatenates, and converts Avro files to Parquet format in S3, which is then directly queried by Athena for analytics and data science.

graph.name: Intent Serverless Data Analytics Architecture
graph.notes: Serverless data processing architecture processing billions of travel/commerce events per day using Kinesis streams, Lambda, Firehose, S3, and Athena.

nodes.name: API Gateway
nodes.notes: Ingests events from client-side JavaScript running on travel partner web pages.

nodes.name: ECS
nodes.notes: Runs containerized backend services and ad servers that publish events via Kinesis Producer Library (KPL).

nodes.name: Ingestion Kinesis Stream
nodes.notes: Buffers incoming high-volume events encoded in binary Avro format with schema fingerprints.

nodes.name: Schema S3 Bucket
nodes.notes: Hosts schema registry definitions and reference data; kept outside VPC to avoid ENI cold-start and scaling issues.

nodes.name: Processor Lambda
nodes.notes: Processes raw streams per event type, resolving schemas using fingerprints from S3.

nodes.name: Processed Kinesis Stream
nodes.notes: Serves as the central integration stream for real-time dashboards, ML models, and downstream storage pipelines.

nodes.name: Kinesis Firehose
nodes.notes: Delivers streamed processed events directly into S3 partitioned by event type.

nodes.name: Storage S3 Bucket
nodes.notes: Stores raw Avro files, which are batch deduplicated, concatenated, and converted to Parquet format.

nodes.name: Athena
nodes.notes: Provides interactive ad-hoc querying on Parquet data in S3 for analysts and data scientists.

edges.notes: API Gateway sends client web event payloads to the Ingestion Kinesis Stream.
ECS services publish Avro-formatted server events to the Ingestion Kinesis Stream.
Ingestion Kinesis Stream triggers Processor Lambda functions for event parsing.
Processor Lambda reads schema definitions and reference data from the Schema S3 bucket.
Processor Lambda writes parsed and enriched events to the Processed Kinesis Stream.
Processed events flow into Kinesis Firehose for batching into S3.
Kinesis Firehose writes raw Avro file batches into the Storage S3 Bucket.
Batch job reads raw Avro files in S3, deduplicates, concatenates, and converts them to Parquet format.
Athena queries the partitioned Parquet files stored in the S3 bucket.
